_notes: US East (N. Virginia) on-demand Linux prices, checked 2026-10-20 via the DoiT instance-pricing pages below (a third-party mirror of AWS list prices). Confirm against the official AWS EC2 pricing page before submitting. Instance choice: the smallest instance that comfortably fits each model in memory. Cost assumes the instance processes snippets one at a time at the latency measured on the local laptop, which is an approximation (see README).

spacy.instance: EC2 c7i.large (2 vCPU, 4 GiB): spaCy sm needs well under 1 GB

gliner.instance: EC2 c7i.xlarge (4 vCPU, 8 GiB): CPU inference for a ~200M-parameter model

ollama.instance: EC2 g6.xlarge (4 vCPU, 16 GiB, 1x NVIDIA L4 24 GB): smallest current NVIDIA GPU instance; a 4B Q4 model fits easily
